differs: TokenTracker counts a billable credit-only row as a conversation with 0 tokens; we emit nothing for it. It replaces a rewritten key with its latest value (a downward correction lowers the total); we keep the field max. It strips the BYOK prefix qoder-custom-<uuid>/ from the model; we keep the model as logged. QODER_DB_PATH (a db file, not a directory) is not read. TokenTracker counts only one conversation per request_id; we count calls per row key.
